Title: Large instances of SAP HANA on Azure

Body.Content:
Today we are announcing general availability of Large instances of SAP HANA on Azure, which are purpose-built hardware configurations for SAP HANA workloads that require memory sizes larger than 0.5 TB. Instances of SAP HANA on Azure are certified for SAP OLTP and OLAP applications in production, and for dev and test use of all scenarios (that is, non-production OLAP and OLTP). 

Get the broadest choice and industry-leading performance when running your SAP workloads on Azure. Spanning Azure Virtual Machines and purpose-built hardware, SAP HANA Large instances scale your SAP HANA workloads up to 32 TB on multimode configurations. 

For more information about these offerings, please read the SAP HANA documentation page.
